price.blurb: Extra-high safety net. Neighbours report sightings.

price.blurb: Rumbles politely in your coat. Great for awkward silences.

price.name: Rowing boat made of biscuits
price.blurb: Floats for six minutes. Dunkable at any point.

price.name: Opera-singing doorstop
price.blurb: Holds the door open. Holds a high C even longer.

price.name: Iceberg, gently pre-owned
price.blurb: Mostly underwater. Like most good surprises.

price.name: Bunting for a beehive
price.blurb: Every day's a festival. The bees are buzzing about it.

price.name: Roller coaster seat (no track)
price.blurb: Sit down. Scream. Imagine the rest.

price.name: Rainy day in a box
price.blurb: Includes puddles, wellies and one slightly sad pigeon.

price.name: Private train for one teddy
price.blurb: Runs on time. Teddy insists on the window seat.

price.name: Single perfect pebble
price.blurb: Hand-picked from ten thousand pebbles. Skips eleven times.

price.name: Welcome mat for a mouse hole
price.blurb: Says 'Wipe Your Paws'. The mouse has never once complied.

price.name: Lighthouse-sized bird bath
price.blurb: Sparrows arrive by appointment. Seagulls just turn up.

price.name: Haunted rocking boat, cheerful
price.blurb: Rocks itself on calm days. Hums sea shanties slightly off-key.

price.name: Sandwich cut into 1,000 triangles
price.blurb: Crusts removed by hand. Lunch takes until dinner.

price.name: Retired carnival dunk tank
price.blurb: Seat still drops on cue. Splashes your opinions away.

price.name: Polar bear-sized hot water bottle
price.blurb: Knitted cover with ears. Stays warm until spring.

price.name: Rainforest, one hectare, very damp
price.blurb: Includes frogs, mist and a toucan who runs the place.

price.name: Pair of stilts for a flamingo
price.blurb: Finally taller than the heron. Balance not guaranteed.

price.name: Bagel big enough to swim through
price.blurb: Sesame seeds the size of pebbles. Toaster sold separately.

price.name: Spare rainbow, slightly faded
price.blurb: Six colours still working. Purple is on holiday.

price.name: Postcard from a snowman
price.blurb: Handwriting a bit drippy. Says the weather is lovely.

price.name: Underground ice-skating cavern
price.blurb: Glittering stalactites, smooth ice and a very echoey spin.

price.name: Desk with a secret slide
price.blurb: Pull the drawer, whoosh to the garden. Meetings now optional.

price.name: Train ticket to the end of the rainbow
price.blurb: Departs whenever it drizzles in sunshine. Pot of gold not included.

price.name: Tiny wheelbarrow for an ant
price.blurb: Carries one crumb. The ant is thrilled.

price.name: Haunted kazoo, very polite
price.blurb: Only hums when you say please. Thanks you afterwards.

price.name: Moat for a sandcastle, deluxe
price.blurb: Pre-filled with seawater. Crabs patrol on weekends.

price.name: Trophy for best nap
price.blurb: Engraved while you were asleep. Well deserved.

price.name: Bunting for a snail race
price.blurb: Very festive. Will still be up next year, as will the race.

price.name: Satin cape for a pigeon
price.blurb: Swishes dramatically. Pigeon now refuses to walk anywhere.

price.name: Haunted chandelier, cheerful
price.blurb: Swings gently to music. Applauds when you dance badly.

price.name: Revolving bookshelf the size of a room
price.blurb: Spin once, find a classic. Spin twice, find the dog.

price.name: Retired lighthouse foghorn choir
price.blurb: Twelve foghorns. One harmony. No more ships, just neighbours.

price.name: Walk-in kaleidoscope
price.blurb: Step inside and become a beautiful pattern. Mind the step.

price.name: Underground hamster theme park
price.blurb: Seven rides, one food court, zero queues for humans.

price.name: Floating tea room for otters
price.blurb: Scones served on their tummies. Very civilised.

price.name: Private waterfall, medium
price.blurb: Runs on weekdays. Takes Sundays off to rest.

price.name: Mountain-top observatory
price.blurb: Sees the stars, the planets and someone's laundry three valleys away.

price.name: Desert island with a doorbell
price.blurb: Nobody ever rings it. The crabs appreciate the gesture.

price.name: Hammock for a sloth, deluxe
price.blurb: Delivered in six weeks. The sloth will review it in eight.

price.name: Doorstop shaped like a walrus
price.blurb: Holds the door. Holds a grudge. Mostly holds the door.

price.name: Retired weather vane rooster
price.blurb: Pointed north for forty years. Now pointing at retirement.

price.name: Bubble-powered scooter
price.blurb: Top speed: gentle. Leaves a trail of joy and slightly soapy pavements.

price.name: Disused windmill, still spinning
price.blurb: Grinds no flour. Just enjoys the breeze, honestly.

price.name: Butterfly hotel, five stars
price.blurb: Room service is mostly nectar. Check-out is whenever.

price.name: Ski lift to the garden shed
price.blurb: For a journey of eleven metres, done in absolute style.

price.name: Snail-mail postbox for snails
price.blurb: Letters arrive eventually. Slime-sealed for freshness.

price.name: Floating castle on a lake
price.blurb: Moat included. Actually, it's mostly moat.

price.name: Single enormous marshmallow
price.blurb: Toast it with a bonfire. Eat it with friends. All of them.

price.name: Accordion that only plays sea shanties
price.blurb: Tried a lullaby once. Ended up hoisting the mainsail.

price.name: Gravity-free bouncing dome
price.blurb: Not actually gravity-free. Just very, very bouncy.

price.name: Pocket-sized marching drum
price.blurb: Announces your arrival at the fridge with a tiny rat-a-tat.

price.name: Vintage observatory telescope dome
price.blurb: Swivels, creaks and finds the one star that's actually a plane.

price.name: Racing go-kart for a goose
price.blurb: Honks at every corner. Wins every race by intimidation.

price.name: Clipboard for a hedgehog
price.blurb: Takes notes on garden security. Mostly writes 'slugs?'

price.name: Revolving door for a beehive
price.blurb: Rush hour has never been so organised. Or so buzzy.

price.name: Bathtub shaped like a teacup
price.blurb: You are the biscuit. Please do not dunk yourself.

price.name: Retired ferry, one route only
price.blurb: Goes to the island and back. Refuses to consider anywhere else.

price.name: Alarm clock that whispers
price.blurb: Wakes you so gently you'll sleep through it every single time.

price.name: Pair of wellies for a duck
price.blurb: For puddles the duck finds personally upsetting.

price.name: Rocket-shaped garden shed
price.blurb: Countdown button included. Has not left the lawn yet.

price.name: Marble-run the size of a house
price.blurb: One marble takes eleven minutes. Everyone cheers at the end.

price.name: Postcard rack for a cottage
price.blurb: Holds 400 postcards. You have received three.

price.name: Disused ski jump, gently sloped
price.blurb: Perfect for sledging, kites and dramatic sighs.

price.name: Sandcastle preservation spray
price.blurb: Keeps your masterpiece standing. The tide disagrees.

price.name: Bunting for a lunchbox
price.blurb: Every sandwich deserves a little celebration.

price.name: Carousel for a guinea pig family
price.blurb: Twelve tiny horses. Guinea pigs prefer the carrot seat.

price.name: Private glacier, modest size
price.blurb: Moves two centimetres a year. Very relaxing to supervise.

price.name: Harp strung with spaghetti
price.blurb: Plays one beautiful note before going al dente.

price.name: Doghouse with a doorbell
price.blurb: Dog rings it at 3am. Every night. For no reason.

price.name: Haunted wardrobe, very tidy
price.blurb: Folds your jumpers overnight. Refuses to explain how.

price.name: Bathtub-sized teacup ride
price.blurb: Spins gently. Biscuits sold separately.

price.name: Calendar with an extra day
price.blurb: Squeezed in between Tuesday and Wednesday. Use wisely.

price.name: Pogo stick for a kangaroo
price.blurb: Kangaroo deeply confused. Bounces anyway.

price.name: Private canyon, one echo
price.blurb: Shout once. The canyon answers politely, then naps.

price.name: Bunk bed for a family of owls
price.blurb: Top bunk is always occupied by whoever is grumpiest.

price.name: Spiral slide from the attic
price.blurb: Forgotten boxes have never been retrieved so quickly.

price.name: Cardboard castle, 3 storeys
price.blurb: Defended by a cat. Rain is its only enemy.

price.name: Retired lunar lander replica
price.blurb: Lands nowhere. Sits on the drive looking brave.

price.name: Raincloud for a single plant
price.blurb: Follows your fern around. Very loyal. Slightly drippy.

price.name: Island shaped like a duck
price.blurb: Quacks at high tide. Locals pretend not to notice.

price.name: Hat for a snowman, formal
price.blurb: Top hat, silk band. Lasts until Thursday's thaw.

price.name: Bowling alley for pigeons
price.blurb: Pins knocked over by enthusiastic pecking. Fair play.

price.name: Opera house, mouse-sized
price.blurb: Sold-out season. Every seat taken by one very fancy mouse.

price.name: Hammock for a hot air balloon
price.blurb: Sway gently at 3,000 feet. Naps have never been so lofty.

price.name: Umbrella stand for a centipede
price.blurb: Fifty slots, fifty brollies. He still forgets one on the bus.

price.name: Retired lighthouse lamp room
price.blurb: Panoramic views, round walls. Nowhere to hang a square picture.

price.name: Tuning fork for a cow
price.blurb: Moos now perfectly in key. The herd has formed a choir.

price.name: Spare corner of the ocean
price.blurb: Very wet. Includes one curious crab who refuses to move out.

price.name: Bookmark that remembers dreams
price.blurb: Saves your page and last night's dream about flying cheese.

price.name: Revolving cottage, sun-tracking
price.blurb: Always faces the sunshine. Postman needs a new map daily.

price.name: Snorkel for a giraffe
price.blurb: Extremely long. Mostly used to sniff clouds.

price.name: Jar of the first snow day
price.blurb: Open in July for instant sledging feelings. Mittens advised.

price.name: Trampoline park on a barge
price.blurb: Bounce down the river. The ducks give your landings scores.

price.name: Self-buttering toast rack
price.blurb: Every slice perfectly buttered. Crumbs still get everywhere.

price.name: Tiny ladder for a ladybird
price.blurb: Seven rungs, hand polished. She flies anyway, but appreciates it.

price.name: Gentle avalanche, small
price.blurb: Delivered to your garden at walking pace. Mostly fluffy.

price.name: Roller skates for a sofa
price.blurb: Rearranging the lounge is now a sport. Cushions wear helmets.

price.name: Clocktower that chimes compliments
price.blurb: Every hour, on the hour: 'Lovely hair today, everyone.'

price.name: Tandem kayak for two otters
price.blurb: Paddles not required. Holding hands strongly encouraged.

price.name: Retired school bell
price.blurb: Ring it at home. Everyone instinctively lines up.

price.name: Thimble-sized grand piano
price.blurb: Fully playable by anyone with very tiny, very confident fingers.

price.name: Gondola for a garden pond
price.blurb: Comes with a striped shirt and one song about frogs.

price.name: Decommissioned mountain cable car
price.blurb: Goes up, comes down. Your living room may need a mountain.

price.name: Sock puppet sculpted in marble
price.blurb: Extremely expressive. Extremely heavy. Not machine washable.

price.name: Bottle of fresh library smell
price.blurb: One sniff and you'll whisper for an hour.

price.name: Fully crewed pirate galleon
price.blurb: Crew only says 'arr' politely. Treasure sold separately.

price.name: Single extra-bouncy balloon
price.blurb: Bounces higher than your expectations. Squeaks when it lands.

price.name: Chandelier made of teaspoons
price.blurb: Sparkles beautifully. Rattles every time someone sneezes.

price.name: Professional tickle consultant
price.blurb: One hour session. Giggles guaranteed or your frown back.

price.name: Disused airport, small
price.blurb: One runway, one gate, one very lonely luggage carousel.

price.name: Robot that folds fitted sheets
price.blurb: Still learning. Currently produces a lumpy origami swan.

price.name: Maze made entirely of pillows
price.blurb: Nobody escapes. Everybody naps.

price.name: Opera cape for a hamster
price.blurb: Swishes dramatically on every wheel rotation.

price.name: Escalator for a tree stump
price.blurb: Rises twelve centimetres. Squirrels queue patiently.

price.name: Raincoat for a lamppost
price.blurb: Bright yellow, toggles included. The lamppost feels very seen.

price.name: Lighthouse-free rocky island
price.blurb: Just rocks and seagulls. The seagulls hold weekly meetings.

price.name: Slippers for a centipede
price.blurb: Fifty pairs, all fluffy. Bedtime now takes forty minutes.

price.name: Bouncing castle for a snail
price.blurb: Bounces very, very slowly. Snail gives five stars eventually.

price.name: Train that only goes to lunch
price.blurb: Departs at noon sharp. Terminates at the sandwich station.

price.name: Jar of birthday cake smell
price.blurb: Open once a year. Candles not included, cheers are.

price.name: Cloud-shaped trampoline pier
price.blurb: Bounce over the sea. Fish rate your landings.

price.name: Umbrella for a sunflower
price.blurb: For grey days. The sunflower sulks less now.

price.name: Spiral slide out of a tower
price.blurb: Ninety metres of wheee. Stairs feel jealous.

price.name: Tuba that plays only lullabies
price.blurb: Very loud. Somehow still makes everyone sleepy.

price.name: Racing track for garden peas
price.blurb: Three lanes, tiny finish line. Peas roll, crowd gasps.

price.name: Private rainforest waterfall
price.blurb: Comes with one frog who insists on being the welcome desk.

price.name: Hat rack shaped like a giraffe
price.blurb: Holds eleven hats. Wears the best one itself.

price.name: Bubble wrap carpet, whole house
price.blurb: Every step a celebration. Sneaking is now impossible.

price.name: Weather-proof kite for a beetle
price.blurb: Beetle reached record heights. Now refuses to come down for dinner.

price.name: Staircase that hums as you climb
price.blurb: Thirteen steps, one full scale. Sneaking downstairs is impossible.

price.name: Revolving wardrobe for socks only
price.blurb: Rotates through 200 socks. Still finds no matching pair.

price.name: Cheese wheel the size of a tyre
price.blurb: Rolls downhill beautifully. Chasing it counts as exercise.

price.name: Hot-air balloon basket, no balloon
price.blurb: Perfect for picnics at ground level. Very, very safe.

price.name: Racing track for garden worms
price.blurb: Finish line moved twice. Nobody noticed. Nobody minded.

price.name: Bunk bed for three tortoises
price.blurb: Top bunk claimed in 2019. Climb still in progress.

price.name: Private snowfall, one evening
price.blurb: Flakes arrive on cue. Your street only. Neighbours suspicious.

price.name: Pencil the length of a bus
price.blurb: Writes one very large word. Sharpener sold separately, and huge.

price.name: Sleepy dragon statue, life-size
price.blurb: Snores gently through hidden speakers. Guards the garden peas.

price.name: Underwater treehouse
price.blurb: Built in coral, not a tree. Fish keep knocking politely.

price.name: Tiny opera glasses for a mouse
price.blurb: Front-row view of the cheese board. Bravo, cheddar.

price.name: Rainbow-striped zebra crossing
price.blurb: Cars stop just to admire it. Ducks cross with extra swagger.

price.name: Musical pyramid in the desert
price.blurb: Each block plays a note. Camels have formed a band.

price.name: Giant teacup ferris wheel
price.blurb: Twelve teacups go round and round. Biscuits strictly forbidden.

price.name: Sleeping bag for a caterpillar
price.blurb: Snug, zip-up and roomy. Comes out a butterfly. No refunds.

price.name: Doorbell for a sandcastle
price.blurb: Ding-dong! The tide would like a word.

price.name: Bicycle helmet for a snail
price.blurb: Top speed remains unchanged. Confidence greatly improved.

price.name: Umbrella hat for a scarecrow
price.blurb: Keeps the straw dry. Crows find it hilarious.

price.name: Library of books about sandwiches
price.blurb: Four hundred volumes. Chapter twelve is just about crusts.

price.name: Juggling lessons for a penguin
price.blurb: Six weeks of practice. Fish keep getting eaten mid-routine.

price.name: Fountain that hums the alphabet
price.blurb: Gets stuck on the letter Q every single afternoon.

price.name: Treasure chest full of buttons
price.blurb: Ten thousand buttons. Not one matches your coat.

price.name: Racing car for a garden gnome
price.blurb: Tiny engine, tiny helmet, enormous ego.

price.name: Concert hall for crickets
price.blurb: Perfect acoustics. Shows start at dusk. Chirping encouraged.

price.name: Lighthouse-shaped birthday cake
price.blurb: Fifteen tiers tall. The candle on top actually rotates.

price.name: Floating library on a lily pad
price.blurb: Overdue fines paid in flies. Frog librarian very strict.

price.name: Castle made entirely of cushions
price.blurb: Forty rooms. Every wall is perfect for flopping into.

price.name: Mountain-top picnic table
price.blurb: Best view on Earth. Bring a very good blanket.

price.name: Theme park run by squirrels
price.blurb: All rides powered by acorns. Queue jumping very common.

price.name: Escalator for a goat
price.blurb: Goats can climb anything. This one prefers to arrive refreshed.

price.name: Umbrella for a puddle
price.blurb: Keeps the puddle dry. The puddle is confused but grateful.

price.name: Bookshelf that alphabetises itself
price.blurb: Works all night. Gets cross about books starting with 'The'.

price.name: Trampoline-bottomed lake
price.blurb: Swim, bounce, swim, bounce. Ducks have filed a complaint.

price.name: Spare shadow, barely worn
price.blurb: Fits most sizes. Follows you everywhere, as is tradition.

price.name: Snow globe you can live in
price.blurb: Two bedrooms. Gets shaken every Thursday. Bring a scarf.

price.name: Wind chime that tells jokes
price.blurb: Every breeze brings a pun. Storms are exhausting.

price.name: Rocket-powered wheelbarrow
price.blurb: Moves compost at alarming speed. Steering optional, sadly.

price.name: Haiku-writing toothbrush
price.blurb: Two minutes of brushing, one tiny poem about molars.

price.name: Cheese moon, half-eaten
price.blurb: Craters are bite marks. Smells faintly of cheddar from orbit.

price.name: Teacup-sized lighthouse keeper
price.blurb: Tiny cap, tiny lamp, enormous sense of duty.

price.name: Pillow stuffed with clouds
price.blurb: Ethically harvested on sunny days. Occasionally drizzles.

price.name: Single noisy jellybean
price.blurb: Crunches with the sound of applause. Eat on stage.

price.name: Racing hovercraft for ducks
price.blurb: Top speed: quack. Lifejackets come in yellow only.

price.name: Staircase made of piano keys
price.blurb: Plays a tune on the way up. A sadder tune on laundry day.
